Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. How's your eyesight？
My eyesight？ What was it again...
Well, good enough to see normally. What about it？
There's a girl in my class who says guys without glasses aren't dating material.
That's unusual...
And apparently she's really particular about frame types and stuff too.
Huh. At that point, I'm almost impressed.
Yeah. But when it comes to weird tastes, Rinko might not be one to talk.
Hey, that's rude. Are you saying I'm weird？
Huh？ You didn't know？
Kobayakawa
Remember the girl I told you about who likes guys with glasses？
Yeah, I remember. The one who's super particular...
Well, get this: a guy from another class confessed to her a while ago. But sadly...
Don't tell me...
Yep, he didn't wear glasses...
So she turned him down？
Yeah. She flat-out told him she doesn't date guys without glasses.
Poor guy, though. He got rejected no matter his looks or personality, right？
Right. Apparently he's pretty good-looking, so the shock was that much bigger.
He'll just have to accept he picked the wrong girl...
Kobayakawa
Remember the glasses girl in my class who got confessed to？
Yeah. She turned him down because he didn't wear glasses.
Actually, there's a sequel.
Get this: the guy put on fake glasses and tried again.
Ah, that's one way. Then she said yes, right？
But apparently, to her, fake glasses don't count.
He got shot down again, and then she lectured him forever on her "glasses aesthetics."
That's... my condolences to him...
If it weren't for her glasses thing, she'd be a sweet, honest girl...
Well, it takes all kinds. Yep.
Don't sum it up so lightly just because it's not your problem.
Ow.
Kobayakawa
About that glasses girl...
Yeah... The guy who retried with fake glasses and still failed.
Right. There's even more news.
Apparently he just can't give up on her. Now he's training to ruin his eyesight. Talk about dedication.
You call that training？
Apparently he's watching TV super close and reading in the dark.
So, is it working？
Who knows. Rinko hasn't heard that much...
But they say love is blind. Nearsighted should be a cinch.
Hm？ What was that？
Sh-Shut up！
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Ever bought bread at the school store at lunch？
Come to think of it, no...
So you've never joined the brutal school store battle.
Ah... I hear it's intense. The popular ones sell out five minutes into lunch.
See, some classrooms are close to the store and some are far, right？
So kids in far classrooms ask kids in close ones to buy for them.
I see. That's why the popular ones get bought up so fast.
Rinko lined up once too, but she didn't hurry there.
By the time it was my turn, they were mostly gone.
The guys in my class dash out the second the bell rings.
That'd be tough for a girl to get into. Especially a short...
Ow.
Hmph. Next time I'll kick my way through the line with this.
(No, no, no.)
Kobayakawa
Remember when I told you about the school store bread？
The cutthroat competition, right？
The most popular one is the katsu sandwich.
It's a little pricey, but apparently it's big and tastes great.
Katsu sandwiches, huh... Such a school story classic.
Second is the curry yakisoba bun.
"An item whose spicy curry aroma whets the appetite."
...Or so the newspaper club's paper said a while back.
I see, so your source is the newspaper club. You read that thing？
Mm... Well, it's just written by kids, right？
For Rinko, it's just a way to kill time.
Uh-huh.
Kobayakawa
About the school store's katsu sandwiches...
Oh, the number one most popular one.
Apparently people used to resell them.
Reselling!?
Yeah. They'd sell them for 100 yen over the real price.
But the teachers found out, and they had to write apology essays.
Hmm. A katsu sandwich people go that far for... Now I kind of want to try one.
Why not take the challenge？ If you get one, Rinko could do you the favor of eating it.
(So I'm the errand boy？)
Kobayakawa
By the way, what happened with the katsu sandwich？ Did you try？
Seemed like a pointless way to wear myself out, so I gave up.
That might be the right call.
After all, that katsu sandwich has a bloody history.
Bloody history？
Yeah. Until last year, people didn't line up like now. They just crowded around the store.
Then a fight over katsu sandwiches knocked people down like dominoes, and they had to call an ambulance.
An ambulance... Why do people crave katsu sandwiches that badly？
A bewitching katsu sandwich.
So anyway, go buy me one.
(How does 'so anyway' follow from that story!?)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Do you know Nogami-sensei, the English teacher？
Nogami...？ No, I don't.
She's a woman teacher, and she's kind of strange.
Strange how？
Hmm. I can't really put it into words, but... it's the vibe she gives off.
That doesn't tell me how she's strange.
You'd probably get it if you met her and talked to her.
Lately people call her "Mystery Nogami."
"Mystery"？ Now I'm even more confused.
Kobayakawa
Remember I told you about Mystery Nogami？
Yeah. The teacher who's strange in some way you can't explain.
Yeah. So, Nogami's actually in charge of the student counseling room.
Student counseling？ Oh... The place you go to talk about your problems.
But does anyone actually use that place？
Apparently it's a secret hot spot.
The counseling room is a hot spot？ Why？
Supposedly, Nogami does tarot readings for you.
A teacher who solves students' problems with fortune-telling...
Kobayakawa
Oh yeah, a friend of Rinko's got a reading from Mystery Nogami the other day.
Ah, the tarot readings in the counseling room...
Yeah, yeah. And she was told to watch out for injuries.
Watch out for injuries？ That's pretty vague.
Right？ Exactly. So she didn't do anything about it, but...
Then the very next day, she sprained her ankle at club practice.
So it came true. Impressive.
Right？ Maybe Rinko should get a reading too...
(It's not even about students' problems anymore.)
Kobayakawa
Hehehe... Actually, I got a reading.
Don't tell me, a tarot reading from Mystery Nogami？
Yep.
That's kind of surprising, though. I thought ▲小早川＊▲ would scoff at fortunes.
...W-Well, that might be Rinko's public image. But Rinko's not that simple.
So what did you ask about？
Love. Hehe... Apparently it's at its absolute best.
But she warned me to keep things moderate, the way high schoolers should.
So she does act like a teacher on that front.
We're... keeping things moderate, right？
Pr-Probably. So far, we're fine... I think. Haha...
Kobayakawa
Do you like art class？
Hmm. I don't really like it or hate it.
Rinko hates it. Especially drawing.
Huh, that's a surprise. You seem like you'd be good at art stuff.
That's way too simplistic. We're doing watercolors in art right now. So depressing.
What are you painting？
The view outside. Trees, buildings.
Is it going well？
Can't you tell from how I'm talking？
Sorry.
Ugh, I can't deal.
(Is it really that bad...)
Kobayakawa
Oh yeah, my watercolor for art... I finally finished the sketch.
How'd it go？
Trees have so many branches and leaves, right？ No way I can draw all that.
Buildings are hard too...
Aren't you overthinking it？ Try drawing more by feel.
And the guys in my class keep asking if a grade-schooler drew it...
Now I kind of want to see it.
No. Look and I kick.
(Telling me that just makes me want to see it more.)
Kobayakawa
About my art class painting...
Ah, the watercolor.
In the end, I didn't finish coloring it in time, so it became homework...
And the coloring is such a pain.
Well, with watercolors, the color is the whole point...
So I've given up and I'm just slapping paint on totally at random.
That's the 'by feel' thing you were talking about, right？
Well, nobody but the art teacher's going to see it anyway.
What if I asked you to show me...
Absolutely not！ Boyfriend or not, there are things I just can't allow.
(What a weird thing to be stubborn about...)
Kobayakawa
I turned in that art assignment...
Oh, that one？ So you're done with painting, the thing you hate？
Yeah... I'm glad about that, but...
What's wrong？
The art teacher got the wrong idea somehow and raved about Rinko's painting.
The grade-schooler painting？
Ngh, shut up.
And then the teacher showed it around to the whole class.
Rinko will never live it down！
Isn't it great your hidden talent got recognized？
Grr！
Bring it？
Sigh...
Kobayakawa
It's a classic, but apparently our school has Seven Mysteries too.
Yeah, that's a classic. So what are they？
The first one Rinko heard is the "Cursed Mirror."
If you go at night, the big mirror on the stair landing drags you in.
Uh-huh. What else？
Let's see, I also heard there's a ghost called "Sachiko-san" in the girls' bathroom.
I forgot the rest. What about you？ Heard any？
Nope, I haven't. Maybe I'll ask some guys in my class.
Then let's each look into it and swap what we find.
It'll at least kill some time.
Roger.
Kobayakawa
So, did you look into the Seven Mysteries？
Yeah. I only got one, though.
Supposedly the portrait of Beethoven in the music room moves at night.
Another classic. But why only Beethoven？ There are other composers' portraits too.
How should I know？ More importantly, got anything new？
I heard about stairs where the number of steps changes.
You count while you climb, and if there are 13 steps, you die.
Then just don't count while you climb.
Well, that kind of nitpick is classic too.
Isn't there anything more interesting？
Yeah... So, keep investigating？
Rogerrr.
Kobayakawa
Now then, without further ado, your Seven Mysteries report, please.
Roger. This time I heard the anatomy model in the science prep room dances at night.
Huh, Rinko heard it runs. Super fast, too.
So the story changes depending on who tells it. Did ▲小早川＊▲ find anything new？
Yep. The Phantom in the Blue Cape.
He appears on the school roof at midnight and spirits away anyone who sees him.
What if ten people saw him at once？ Would he take all ten？
More to the point, if the story got passed down, some witnesses didn't get taken.
These Seven Mysteries are starting to fall apart...
Well, they're just kid stuff anyway, right？
If stories like this are popular, high schoolers are just kids.
So the next one's the last. Wonder what it'll be.
I'll let myself expect something from the last one, at least.
(If I call her a kid, she'll kick me. Better not.)
Kobayakawa
Found any more of the Seven Mysteries since then？
Yep. A fallen samurai ghost who shows up in the courtyard.
If you run into him, you're supposed to throw feed from the chicken coop at him. No idea why.
Okay, now my new one.
Wait. You've got another one？
Yeah. Someone told me about the glowing ginkgo tree.
That makes eight.
Huh？ ...Oh, you're right.
So it's really the Eight Mysteries？
If we kept digging, I bet even more would turn up.
Probably. Well, I guess that's it for the investigation. It was kind of fun.
(Kind of？)
Kobayakawa
The other day we had a surprise bag check. They should cut that out. It's not the old days.
Do they do that in your class too？
Yeah. We had one recently too.
You okay？ Get anything taken？
I didn't have anything on me, so.
Rinko was fine this time too. Though they took my manga once before...
Novels are usually okay, but manga isn't. It feels like unfair discrimination.
The whole Japanese education system is...
(Way to jump straight to that.)
Kobayakawa
Hey, listen.
What？
At the last bag check, my homeroom teacher Ooyama confiscated some manga from a guy.
And then apparently he read it in the staff room.
He took it so the student couldn't read it, then read it himself？
Right？ And he got hooked, so he asked the owner to bring the series from volume one.
Hahaha... So he got sucked in himself.
Now he's read everything up to the latest volume, and he's asking when the next one comes out.
But the bag checks...
Still going.
Kobayakawa
Remember my homeroom teacher who got hooked on the manga he confiscated？
Yeah, I remember.
Well, it seems something woke up in him. He's started reading all kinds of others.
Sounds like he had no immunity to manga, then suddenly read a really good one...
Yeah, something like that. He doesn't look like he'd read manga normally.
How old is this teacher？
Hmm... Around 40？
Awakening to manga at 40, huh.
And people keep seeing him at manga cafes. Rinko saw him the other day too.
Hahaha... That might be a serious case.
Kobayakawa
Hey, hey, listen to this one.
What's up？
Ooyama teaches modern Japanese. In essay time, he assigned a book report on our favorite manga.
Ah, the teacher who got hooked on manga.
Yeah... What do you think？ Rinko bets he's researching good manga.
Hahaha... Reading the reports to scout for good manga, huh.
Right？ Sounds plausible, doesn't it？ If so, that's abuse of power！
But if he likes manga that much, won't he let it slide at bag checks？
No, the opposite. He'll confiscate more so he can read them, I bet.
You seem really mad. What's wrong？
...He took my CD the other day. He's hooked on manga, but he told Rinko "girls shouldn't listen to barbaric music"！
He just doesn't get it！ Geez！
(Is she mad about the confiscation or about him judging her music？)
Kobayakawa
You know the shed in the corner of the field？ The equipment hut？
Yeah. The one with the gym equipment nobody uses, right？
Apparently a cat's moved in there lately.
The sports club guys are feeding it. They even named it. Charlotte.
Well, that hut has no door, so anything can go in and out. Handy for a cat.
And her belly's really big now. Looks like she'll have kittens soon.
I see. So she was looking for a place to give birth.
Yeah, looks like it. Someone even started a "Help Charlotte Give Birth Club."
Did you join, ▲小早川＊▲？
Rinko？ Flocking with everyone？ Not her style.
Anyway, a cat giving birth isn't something people should mess with. That's the cat's business.
(Suddenly so philosophical again...)
Kobayakawa
Hey, hey, Charlotte had her kittens！
Ah, that cat.
And they're sooo cute！ They're this tiny, and so fluffy.
It's just, like, kyaaa～！
Well, kittens are definitely cute.
And there are four, and every one is adorable. Ahh, geez, I have to go see them again.
(She's unusually hyper. She must really love them...)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, have you been feeling lonely lately？
What's this？ Oh, I get it. As long as I have ▲小早川＊▲...
Don't get the wrong idea！
Ow！ Huh？
Kittens. KITTENS. I'm looking for people to take Charlotte's kittens.
Oh, that's what you mean...
So, can you keep one at your place？ Actually, all four is fine too.
I live alone, so there'd be no one to look after them while I'm out, right？
...I see. Rinko's been begging for a cat for ages, but my parents just won't...
(She's really devoted to them...)
Kobayakawa
All four of Charlotte's kittens found homes.
Oh, that's great.
It's good news, but when I think I won't see them at school anymore...
Lonely？
Well, a little. But it'd be hard for Charlotte to keep raising them at school anyway.
Raising kids, huh. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？ Being a mom someday？
Hmm, sounds hard. I don't really know how to deal with kids. Oh, but my own kids would be cute, I guess.
...I feel like this is where the girlfriend gets flustered.
...？ Oh... Idiot！
Kobayakawa
Do you know Miyauchi-sensei, the school nurse？
Not well, but she's the pretty one, right？
...Hmph, that's the first thing you say. Such an old-guy thing to think！ Gross, gross.
That's what I get for saying she's pretty？
She is pretty, but more than that, she's kind.
She's really careful treating injuries too. Why not look at what's inside people？
Yeah, yeah.
So what about you？ Do you like that kind, motherly type？
Not bad. But the type I like is, let's see, younger...
Uh-huh, younger？ And？
...Someone like ▲小早川＊▲.
Hmm... Oh, okay. Then... that's fine, I guess.
Kobayakawa
Remember I told you about Miyauchi-sensei, the nurse？
Oh yeah, you did.
Apparently she's got quite a few die-hard fans among the guys.
I heard they fake being sick to hang out in the nurse's office.
Well, that's pretty typical.
And one faked it so often she got worried something was really wrong and almost sent him to the hospital.
I hear she's a bit of an airhead, so she was probably really worried. Maybe that's part of her charm.
An airhead, huh... "Rinko doesn't geeet it～？" Like that？
(Probably not...)
Kobayakawa
Maybe Rinko's a fan of Miyauchi-sensei too.
How come？
Because unlike the other teachers, she doesn't nag about grades and rules.
Well, maybe that's just how school nurses are.
No, she's an adult who actually gets it. Yeah.
It's rare for ▲小早川＊▲ to warm up to a teacher.
I'm not warming up to her. I acknowledge her. Don't get that wrong.
Yeah, yeah.
Miyauchi-sensei is hereby certified as Rinko's ally.
(So the other teachers are enemies.)
Kobayakawa
I'm so disillusioned... Miyauchi, the nurse.
Demoted to no "sensei"？ What happened？
I felt sick and was resting in the nurse's office, but I got bored and listened to music, and Miyauchi caught me...
She got mad？
No, the opposite. She said if it made me feel better, it was fine. Then she snuck me snacks and juice...
Sounds like a good deal？
She's got no boundaries. She's just careless. That's no good.
Ugh, I guess there's no such thing as a perfect adult.
(You're a tough one, ▲小早川＊▲.)
Kobayakawa
Don't you think the principal's assembly talks are way too long？
Yeah. Everyone thinks that.
The way he talks just makes you sleepy.
Right？ It's like some kind of hypnosis.
Huh？ You too？ I heard a certain type is immune, though？
A certain type？
You'll get mad if I say it, so I won't.
I won't get mad. Go ahead.
You know, THAT！ ...Idiots？
Hey！
See, you got mad！
Kobayakawa
By the way, wasn't the principal's last talk especially long？
How does he find so much to talk about every time？
But his vocabulary seems pretty small, actually.
And sometimes he throws in weird dad jokes.
Yeah. And they fall totally flat.
Right, right. Nobody knows how to react.
What was the pun last time...？
"This committee... I'm com-MIT-ted to it！"
Kobayakawa
I came up with a way to stay awake during the principal's talk.
A way to stay awake？
In a word: send him psychic waves.
Like telekinesis？
Yeah. To beat hypnosis, that's the only way, right？
Fight fire with fire, huh...
You focus your mind and beam "Hurry up and end～, hurry up and end～" at him.
So I want you to help too.
Help beam psychic waves？
Well, I'm kidding.
Kobayakawa
Don't you think the principal's talk got a little shorter？
Hmm. Now that you mention it...
This might actually be working...
What's working？
Psychic waves！
You actually did it...
Well, worth a shot, right？
Weren't you just not sleepy because you were concentrating？
Then want to try it together next time？
I'm beaming psychic waves too？
If we combine our powers, I think we can cut five more minutes...
(She's so pure about this kind of thing...)
Kobayakawa
The sports tournament's coming up, right？
The sports tournament, huh...
That whole "Everyone pull together and fight！" thing. Spare me.
Sounds fun.
Team sports just aren't Rinko's thing！
Give it a try. It might be kind of fun？
Well, either way, Rinko's catching a cold that day. What a shame.
(She's planning to skip...)
Kobayakawa
Ugh. The sports tournament is so depressing...
Are you bad at sports, ▲小早川＊▲？
Not really, no？ I'm actually a pretty fast runner.
Huh, really？ That's a surprise.
I don't mind individual sports.
Team sports are a pain, so I pass！
There you go again... Anyway, don't skip it. Show up, okay？
What's that？ Are you a teacher？ Stop it.
(Her teachers must have it rough...)
By the way, what are you doing for the tournament？
Kobayakawa
Oh, that... Dodgeball.
That takes me back. I played it all the time in grade school.
With that, I can get out fast and leave the court, right？
Then I get to watch from the sidelines.
Don't say that. You should just have fun...
You told me to show up, so I'm showing up... Praise me already！
(Well, maybe she's grown a little...)
How'd the tournament go？
Kobayakawa
I planned to get out fast, but Rinko ended up the only one left...
So much for your plan...
Argh, I'm so frustrated！
Huh？
Rinko got the other team down to one person all by herself...
Whoa！ You really put up a fight？
I want a rematch！
So it was fun after all？
Not really, no？ I just didn't want to lose！
(Well, if she had fun, that's good.)
Kobayakawa
We're making stuffed animals in home ec next time.
Huh, you do stuff like that in home ec？
What should Rinko make？
Want me to decide for you？
Well, I'll hear it as a suggestion.
Let's see... How about a cat？ ▲小早川＊▲ likes cats, right？
A cat... Well, if I feel like it.
Show me when it's done？
If it turns out well, I could give it to you.
Nice. I'll look forward to it.
How's that stuffed animal coming along？
Kobayakawa
Pretty smoothly, I think.
So ▲小早川＊▲ sews too, huh.
What's that supposed to mean？ That's seriously rude.
I didn't mean it like...
I'm a girl, you know？ I can at least mend clothes if they tear.
That kind of thing makes me kind of happy.
Hmm, so you're into that kind of thing？
Yeah, yeah. But can you really sew？
I can. Probably...
(Her fingers are covered in cuts, though...)
Oh yeah, how did the home ec stuffed animal turn out？
Kobayakawa
Ah, it's almost done.
So what did you end up making？
A calico.
Oh, so you went with a cat？
Well, yeah. Since you asked for one.
All that's left is attaching the head, body, and tail.
Then I'm looking forward to it！
Huh... You're looking forward to it？
Well, sure...
Hmm...
How'd that thing go？
Kobayakawa
Wh-What thing？
The cat plushie. You said it was almost done.
Oh... Did I say that？
You did. I was even thinking about where to put it.
You might want to give up on that...
Don't tell me... it failed？
Someone in my class called it "Object X"...
Now I kind of want to see that...
No！ You asked for a cat.
So I'm not giving you anything that isn't a cat. End of discussion！
(Now I'm more curious about Object X...)
Do you have close friends, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Well, a few. Outside my class, I guess there's a girl named Onodera.
What do you talk about？
We like the same music, so the Killer Bambis and stuff.
Huh, that's kind of a relief.
What's that mean？
I was worried you'd been seeing your friends less since you're always with me.
You don't need to worry about that. That's for Rinko to decide.
Yeah？ But you have to take care of your friendships too.
Acting all older and wiser. I said don't worry.
Okay, got it.
Kobayakawa
Rinko had a fight with Onodera...
Onodera-san, the one you mentioned... What happened？
We were supposed to go look at CDs together, but Rinko bailed at the last minute.
How come？
I thought I'd texted her that I couldn't go, but it never sent... She waited an hour.
Ouch, that's rough on her.
That's how we ended up fighting...
You want to make up, right, ▲小早川＊▲？
Not really. If she doesn't want to, then fine...
Is that really okay？ The longer a fight drags on, the harder it is to make up.
Why not reach out first, ▲小早川＊▲？ Don't be stubborn about it.
I'll think about it...
So, did you make up with Onodera-san？
Kobayakawa
No... I tried talking to her, but it felt like she was shutting me out...
I see... Girls can't exactly settle it with a fistfight by the river.
Guys really do that？
...Actually, I don't think anyone really does.
Have you ever fought with a friend？
Sure. When that happened, I just apologized honestly.
I see...
Why not be honest too, ▲小早川＊▲？ If you back off because she brushed you off a bit, you'll never make up.
Okay...
Kobayakawa
Hey... thanks.
For what？
I made up with Onodera. She dodged me a little again, but when I worked up the nerve to apologize, it was easy.
Yeah？ That's great！
Well, yeah...
What？ You look like you want to say something.
You were right. I have to take care of my friends too.
Right. You can't talk to me about boyfriend stuff, can you？
...True. I'll complain to my friends about my boyfriend a whooole lot！
What, you've got that many complaints？
Kidding... I think you're a good boyfriend. Hehe...
